blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Senators have closed ranks against a proposed tax on coffee products, warning that it would burden poor consumers, hurt local farmers and make an everyday staple more expensive. Sen. Panfilo “Ping” Lacson on Saturday said his colleagues were nearly unanimous in considering the proposal anti-poor, noting that some Filipinos, particularly those in rural communities, could barely afford more than coffee and pandesal for breakfast. “Halos nagkakaisa ang sentimyento ng senador diyan na parang napaka-anti-poor kasi ang mga kababayan natin, lalo sa malayong lugar sa bukid, talagang halos ang iba kahit pandesal na lang ang kinakain,” Lacson said in […]...
